project_type: Offline-first Android Flutter app (Drift local DB + Supabase remote sync)
build_system: Flutter SDK + pub; code generation with build_runner (drift_dev, riverpod_generator, freezed, json_serializable, go_router_builder). Run: dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs
test_framework: flutter_test (dart:test) for Dart; pgTAP for SQL. DB tests run via: supabase test db. Dart tests: flutter test
build_command: flutter pub get && dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs
test_command: flutter analyze && flutter test && supabase db reset && supabase test db
verification_instructions: 1. flutter pub get  2. dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs  3. flutter analyze (must exit 0)  4. flutter test (must exit 0, no skips)  5. supabase db reset (must succeed from scratch)  6. supabase test db (all pgTAP tests green). If Docker/Supabase CLI unavailable, steps 5-6 are skipped and noted.
snapshot_or_generated_files: lib/data_platform/db/app_database.g.dart, lib/**/*.g.dart, lib/**/*.freezed.dart, lib/app/router/**/*.g.dart. Regenerate with: dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs
environment_constraints: Work only against local Supabase (supabase start, supabase db reset). Never touch remote. Never edit already-applied migrations. Next migration number is 0018. Docker/Supabase CLI may be unavailable — if so, static analysis only; write migrations and tests anyway.
contribution_requirements: Architecture rules (binding): widgets never touch Drift/Supabase/HTTP; repositories write only Drift + outbox in same tx; domain code is pure Dart; IDs are client-generated UUIDs (v7); append-only tables never updated in place; deletes are soft; use Result<T>/typed failures. Navigation rules: typed GoRouter routes only (GoRouteData), no Navigator.push/MaterialPageRoute in lib/features/. Layout rules: AppPage + PageLayout presets, no raw Scaffold in lib/features/. Theme: context.colors/context.scheme, no Color(0x...) in features/. One concern per migration file; no editing applied migrations.
key_patterns: Sync write pattern: SyncedWrite.writeSynced(writeRow, table, rowId, op, payload) — inserts outbox row in same Drift transaction. Pull apply pattern: SyncApply._applyOne checks for pending outbox rows before overwriting local data; uses shouldApplyRemoteVersion for conflict resolution. Mappers: FeedItemSyncedTable / FeedTransactionSyncedTable implement SyncedTable<T> with toPayload()/fromRemote(). Architecture test pattern: file scanning with dart:io in test/architecture/*_test.dart. BatchMetrics pattern (for FeedMetrics): pure Dart factory constructor, table-driven unit tests. pgTAP tests: begin; select plan(N); ... select * from finish(); rollback; — use pgtap helpers has_function, ok, is, throws_ok.
directory_structure: lib/features/feed/ — domain/feed_models.dart (domain classes), data/feed_repository.dart + *_synced_table.dart (data layer), presentation/ (screens, providers, routes). lib/data_platform/db/ — app_database.dart + tables/*.dart (Drift schema). lib/data_platform/sync/ — sync_engine.dart, cuco_care_sync_engine.dart, sync_apply.dart, supabase_remote_sync_api.dart. supabase/migrations/ — numbered SQL files (highest: 0017). supabase/tests/database/ — pgTAP files. test/features/ — feature unit+widget tests. test/architecture/ — linting tests via file scanning. docs/ — feed.md (spec), feed-module-review.md (to create). docs/adr/ — empty (to populate with 7 ADRs).
